description: Find pieces of the library by meaning, in French or English: shots, transitions, effects, animations, camera moves, 3-D objects, sounds, music, styles and templates (whole films ready to fill). An empty query lists a kind (`total` says how many there are; `offset` gives the next page). mine: true lists the user's own pieces instead (« Mes pièces »: the scenes they kept and the pieces they wrote, with create_piece), the latest first, with what their last checks said. Returns ids to use with the other tools.

kinds.description: Keep to these kinds of pieces

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer (default en)

mine.description: true: the user's own pieces, not the library's

offset.description: Skip this many results: the next page of a long list

query.description: What is wanted, in plain words: "a phone showing the app", "soft transition", "keyboard sound", "retro"…

name: search_library
title: Search the library
